_module.description: Change detection threshold configuration -- per-dimension comparison thresholds for physics diff generation. All fields support runtime hot-reload [D24].
_module.jolt_reference: N/A (incremental serialization is custom-implemented by the physics system)

_comment.positionEpsilon: Position change threshold (meters), float, >=0, default 0.001 (1mm), displacement smaller than this does not produce a position change [D15]
_comment.rotationEpsilon: Rotation change threshold (radians), float, >=0, default 0.00017 (~0.01deg), angle change smaller than this does not produce a rotation change
_comment.linearVelocityEpsilon: Linear velocity change threshold (m/s), float, >=0, default 0.01, velocity change smaller than this does not produce a velocity change
_comment.angularVelocityEpsilon: Angular velocity change threshold (rad/s), float, >=0, default 0.001, angular velocity change smaller than this does not produce an angular velocity change

_restart_note: All fields support hot-reload, no need to restart the physics thread.
